name: Tyson Foods New Holland Poultry Plant - New Holland PA

fieldNotes.location: Roster lat/lng (40.09554,-76.086927) is correct to within a few hundred metres and resolves to the plant. Google Places returns 'Tyson New Holland', 403 S Custer Ave, New Holland PA 17557 at exactly that point. Confirmed on the ground: a Tyson monument sign at the S Custer Ave entrance reads 'Tyson - NEW HOLLAND COMPLEX' and a second blue sign reads 'Tyson - NEW HOLLAND FACILITY, 403 S. CUSTER AVE' (Street View, April 2025). Campus center pinned at 40.0960,-76.0860.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Continuous chain-link perimeter fence with privacy slats around the plant and yard, confirmed in four Street View headings along S Custer Ave. Employee/visitor parking sits OUTSIDE the fence; the plant and truck yard sit inside. A gate with a booth beside it straddles the entrance drive roughly 60 m in from S Custer Ave (~40.09510,-76.08644). An on-site wayfinding sign at the entrance lists 'Guard House' among the destinations.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small purpose-built booth with a metal awning roof, windows on multiple faces and Tyson branding, standing beside the gate leaf in the fence line at ~40.09510,-76.08644. Read at fov 4.5 deg from the Street View pano at 40.094887,-76.087214 (April 2025). Corroborated by the entrance wayfinding sign listing 'Guard House'.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: The entrance drive from S Custer Ave to the gate measures ~62 m, which stacks roughly 3 tractor-trailers before a queue reaches the public road. Flagged true on that geometry, though wide paved aprons flank the drive and a second (north) access exists, so the practical risk is moderate rather than severe.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Two accesses: the guarded main gate off S Custer Ave (40.09483,-76.08707 at the road) and an unguarded service drive off the street at the north edge of the property (~40.09882,-76.08671). The north drive is narrow and reads as a service/back route rather than a primary truck lane.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: A yellow-hatched pavement island is visible near the gate at z20-21, suggesting a split in/out lane pair, but the lane count could not be resolved cleanly. Recorded 1/1; treat as unverified.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Multi-building campus: dock banks on the main plant's east and south faces, a separate warehouse/freezer building inside the yard, and the south building's east face. ~25-35 trailers were seen backed in at once. Total door count estimated at 50-60 from overhead; band 50+ but the exact count is an estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer parking without tractors: a fan of ~18 trailers in the east yard, ~10 in the plant's south-west apron, ~9 at the south building, plus scattered rows. Comfortably 50+.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~70 counted across the campus in the current imagery; approximate.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on different building faces and a physically separate south building with its own east-face dock apron.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: One fenced campus containing the main processing plant, an inboard warehouse/freezer, a south building group, several outbuildings and a north service building.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale positively isolated in imagery. Note this reads as a further-processing plant, not a live-haul slaughter complex: no poultry holding sheds and no open-sided cage trailers are present, only dry vans and reefers. A receiving scale is therefore less likely than at a kill plant. Recorded false, unverified.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property in any of the imagery examined.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: New Holland is a small Lancaster County borough; the plant's east, south and west edges abut cropland. Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Borough setting with a lattice communications tower on the property itself; no coverage concern.
fieldNotes.boundary: Perimeter traced to the developed/fenced campus (plant, truck yard, associated parking, south building). Tyson-associated mowed ground and a service building extend further north toward W Jackson St and are not included in the acreage. Note Savencia Cheese / Zausner Foods (400 S Custer Ave) is a separate operator on the WEST side of S Custer Ave and is excluded, as are the trailers parked in that lot.

citations.claim: Street View pano at 40.094887,-76.087214 shows a Tyson monument sign reading 'Tyson - NEW HOLLAND COMPLEX' and a blue sign reading 'Tyson - NEW HOLLAND FACILITY, 403 S. CUSTER AVE' at the plant entrance, with the fenced, operating plant behind it.
Google Places returns a single result, 'Tyson New Holland', 403 S Custer Ave, New Holland PA 17557 at 40.09554,-76.0869269.

verification.rationale: Operator confirmed from current on-site Tyson branding (April 2025 Street View) plus the Google Places listing. Web search was unavailable for this run, so no news/closure sweep was performed; the plant is visibly active in current imagery (trailers docked, yard full, plumes from the stacks). Divestiture/closure gauntlet run 2026-08-12: this site was checked by name against Tyson's announced closures 2023-2026 and does not appear on that list.

divestitureCitation.claim: Tyson closure sweep 2023-2026 checked this site by name against the announced-closure list (2023 poultry: Noel MO, Corydon IN, Glen Allen VA, Van Buren AR; 2024: Perry IA pork, North Little Rock AR; 2025: Emporia KS beef, 2x Original Philly PA prepared; 2026: Lexington NE beef closed Jan 20 2026, Rome GA prepared closing May 31 2026). This site does not appear on it. Checked against agriculturedive.com, kcur.org and wrdw.com reporting; swept 2026-08-12.
